_doc: Monotone-shrink ratchet budget for the conformance matrix. Each key is the exact suite name emitted by conformance-matrix.py; `ledgered` is the allowed count of ledgered gaps (the XFail/Skip column). The gate asserts the live count EQUALS this budget: a larger count (a regressed or newly-ledgered gap) fails RED, and a smaller count (a fixed gap) also fails RED until the budget is lowered here to lock the gain. This budget is authoritative and may only ever be edited DOWNWARD; a raise must be justified in review. Reasons describe the technical gap only.

SPARQL 1.1/1.2 evaluation (full corpus).note: 5 upstream-errata fixtures with non-canonical XSD lexicals (cast-decimal/double/float, coalesce01, plus-1-corrected); the entailment-regime cases (OWL-Direct/DL via the SHOIQ(D) tableau, RIF-rule, RDF-axiomatic-triple) are all native now

Entailment (OWL 2 DL consistency).note: vendored W3C OWL 2 suite (261 consistency/inconsistency cases) graded against the OWL-Direct SHOIQ(D) tableau; 4 ledgered divergences, each typed in crates/sparql-conformance/src/owl2.rs::LEDGER — 2 bottom-property (the empty built-in role reads as an ordinary named role; the run RAISES the builtin-role boundary for it), 1 empty-domain (OWL 2 forbids the empty interpretation domain) and 1 withheld run (a cyclic class expression the parser refuses). Lowered from 5: the datatype-range decider gives the tableau a concrete domain, so a functional data property with two different literal values now clashes instead of merging the two literal nodes, and new-feature-keys-006 agrees with its published verdict. Lowered from 28 before that: the reverse mapping now reads the role characteristics (transitive/symmetric/asymmetric/reflexive/irreflexive/inverse-functional), role and property disjointness, owl:differentFrom and owl:AllDifferent, owl:AllDisjointClasses, owl:hasKey, owl:hasSelf and owl:NegativePropertyAssertion instead of dropping them, and the sameAs re-statement pass no longer tries to put a literal in subject position. No ledgered divergence is an unsoundness. Consistency-shaped: this row does NOT measure the OWL 2 RL rule table. The corpus is also a SUBSET: it vendors 261 of the 482 consistency-shaped cases in the upstream manifest, and the harness's OWL2-DL-EXCLUDED line measures the other 221 — 156 of them the tableau decided when probed (93 consistent, 63 inconsistent), so the exclusion was payload-size triage, not a capability limit; 30 do not terminate under a 40 s ceiling (the previously-claimed 32 was inherited, not measured), 12 are withheld (7 reasoner, 5 parse) and 23 carry no RDF/XML premise. Reading 257/261 as coverage of what W3C published overstates it

Entailment (OWL 2 RL, W3C entailment tes.note: W3C's own OWL 2 entailment tests (crates/sparql-conformance/entailment-suite/w3c-owl2-rl/, fetched from https://www.w3.org/2009/11/owl-test/all.rdf), graded through purrdf_entail::entails() — the independent oracle for the rule table, which until it existed was scored only by fixtures authored alongside the rules. 50 cases: all 27 positive entailments W3C places inside the RL profile under RDF-BASED semantics, plus ALL 23 negative entailments (soundness is owed on every case, so nothing is filtered by profile there). The negative lane is 23/23 — no triple W3C publishes as NOT entailed was ever reached, so no unsoundness was found. The positive lane is 22 of 27, and the 5 ledgered divergences are each typed in crates/sparql-conformance/src/owl2_rl.rs::LEDGER — 3 schema-conclusion, 1 construct-outside-rl, 1 imports-unresolved. All 5 are structural limits of OWL 2 RL itself: every head in Profiles §4.3 Tables 4–9 is an assertional triple over named terms or `false`, so no conforming RL rule set derives a schema axiom. 0 are ACTIONABLE. Lowered from 7: webont-i5-5-005 concludes an anonymous owl:unionOf class and webont-i5-26-010 an anonymous owl:Restriction. Neither says anything about any individual; each says a CLASS EXISTS, which the RDF-Based semantics' own COMPREHENSION CONDITIONS license — subject to a typing side condition on the operands (unionOf(a) is licensed only for a in IC, and i5-5-005's premise asserting `a rdf:type owl:Class` is exactly why the case is a published entailment rather than a published non-entailment). Only the scaffolds the conclusion names are minted, over blank nodes checked absent from BOTH documents, and membership in a comprehended union is decided by looking for ONE disjunct in the closure — sound trivially, and complete because a consistent Horn theory entails a ground disjunction only by entailing a disjunct. Lowered from 8 before that: chain2trans1 concludes `p rdf:type owl:TransitiveProperty` from `p owl:propertyChainAxiom (p p)`. That axiom abbreviates a universally quantified Horn implication, which is decided by GENERALISATION ON CONSTANTS — freeze `_:a p _:b . _:b p _:c` over constants the premise does not mention, re-run the same table, and prp-spo2 (one of the 78) derives `_:a p _:c`, which is transitivity's own condition; the axiom's other conjunct, p ∈ IOOP, is a lookup in the premise's closure. Deliberately NOT routed through the DL tableau, whose reverse mapping DROPS owl:propertyChainAxiom and would therefore answer a confident wrong False. Lowered from 16 before that: eight cases that conclude a NEGATIVE FACT (an owl:differentFrom, a membership in an anonymous owl:complementOf class) or an owl:AllDifferent collection now AGREE, reached by refutation — assert the conclusion's negation into the premise and re-run the SAME rule table, whose seventeen `false`-concluding rules are the profile's own inconsistency calculus, over a premise whose consistency was established first — and an owl:AllDifferent lowers to the n(n-1)/2 pairwise inequalities OWL 2 defines it as, every one of which must refute. Lowered from 17 before that: webont-differentfrom-001 is reached by a rule declared OUTSIDE every specification table (ext-eq-diff-sym), and every rendered report carries an `extension` line so a caller that must act only on normative conclusions can tell. NONE of these mechanisms adds a rule: rules(Regime::OwlRl) and implemented(Regime::OwlRl) are still exactly the same 78 and extensions(Regime::OwlRl) is still the one ext-eq-diff-sym. This row, not `OWL-RL 78 / 78`, is the W3C entailment-conformance measurement

rdflib LSP drop-in gate.note: rdflib-suite strict xfails: Graph-subclass set-operator identity, rdf:List/Collection mutation, Result.bindings/SELECT* subselect projection, graph-prefix forwarding, aggregate/nested-FILTER evaluation, and ConjunctiveGraph legacy semantics
